grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成影响，或动作持续到现在，使用have/has been + 过去分词结构，且主语是动作的承受者。 用于强调动作的接受者，或不知道/不必提及动作的执行者。本课中表达visitor被要求保持清洁，baskets被放置在树下，强调的是动作承受者的状态。

text.title: A walk through the woods 林中散步

lines.en: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods. It is a famous beauty spot. On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods. Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy. Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere. Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods. What I saw made me very sad. I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators. The little baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres
lines.zh: 我住在一个由美丽的树林环绕的古老的小镇上。这是一个著名的风景胜地。每逢星期天，有许许多人从城里来观赏我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。游客已被告知要保持树林的整洁。树下都已设置了废物筐，但是人们仍到处扔垃圾。上星期三我到树林里去散步。我所见到的一切使我非常难过。我数了一下，有7辆旧汽车和3个旧冰箱。废物筐是空的，而满地都是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎，空瓶子和生锈的空罐头盒。在垃圾堆中我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：“凡在此树林里丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置"。

lines.en: The writer lives in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
Because it is a famous beauty spot.
Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
Litter baskets have been placed under the trees.
The writer went for a walk in the woods.
Yes, he saw a lot of rubbish.
He saw a sign among the rubbish.
The sign said, ‘Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted.
B Someone has aired it. It has already been aired.
Someone has cleaned them. They have already been cleaned.
Someone has emptied it. It has already been emptied.
Someone has sharpened it. It has already been sharpened.
Someone has turned them on. They have already been turned on.
Someone has bought them. They have already been bought.
Someone has swept it. It has already been swept.
Someone has taken them to school. They have already been taken to school.
Someone has invited them. They have already been invited.
Someone has told them. They have already been told.
C It hasn't been aired yeet. It will be aired tomorrow.
They haven't been cleaned yet. They will be cleaned tomorrow.
It hasn't been emptied yet. It will be emptied tomorrow.
It hasn't been sharpened yet. It will be sharpened tomorrow.
They haven't been turned on yet. They will be turned on tomorrow.
They haven't been watered yet. They will be watered tomorrow.
It hasn't been repaired yet. It will be repaired tomorrow.
It hasn't been dusted yet. It will be dusted tomorrow.
They haven't been corrected yet. They will be corrected tomorrow.
It hasn't been shut yet. It will be shut tomorrow.
